name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
description: Guarantees 100 days of wage employment per year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.
benefit_description: 100 days guaranteed employment per household. Daily wages vary by state (₹267-374). Unemployment allowance if work not provided within 15 days.
how_to_apply: Apply at Gram Panchayat → Get Job Card → Demand work → Get employed within 15 days → Wages credited to bank

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
description: Financial assistance for construction of pucca houses to eligible rural households who are houseless or living in kutcha/dilapidated houses.
benefit_description: Financial assistance + 90 days MGNREGA wages. Beneficiary selected from SECC 2011 data. Geo-tagged construction monitoring.
how_to_apply: Auto-selected from SECC data → Verified by Gram Sabha → Sanctioned by Block → Construction started → Installments released on progress

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U)
description: Affordable housing for urban poor under 'Housing for All' mission with interest subsidy on home loans.
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
benefit_description: 6.5% interest subsidy for EWS/LIG (up to ₹6 lakh loan). 4% for MIG-I (up to ₹9 lakh). 3% for MIG-II (up to ₹12 lakh).
how_to_apply: Apply online at PMAY-U portal or through CSC → Select CLSS component → Apply through lending institution → Get interest subsidy

name: National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) - Old Age Pension
description: Monthly pension to destitute elderly persons aged 60+ years belonging to BPL families under Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme.
benefit_description: Central: ₹200/month (60-79 years), ₹500/month (80+ years). States add their own contribution making total ₹1000-3000/month.
how_to_apply: Apply at Gram Panchayat / ULB → Verified by Block/Municipality → Sanctioned by District → Monthly pension credited to bank

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0
description: Free LPG connection to women from BPL households to replace unclean cooking fuels and improve health.
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
benefit_amount: Free LPG connection + first refill + stove
benefit_description: Free deposit-free LPG connection, first refill, and hot plate (stove) to eligible women. ₹1,600 per connection.
how_to_apply: Visit nearest LPG distributor → Fill Ujjwala 2.0 form → Submit Aadhaar + ration card → Get free LPG connection

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
description: Collateral-free loans up to ₹10 lakhs for micro/small enterprises under three categories: Shishu, Kishore, and Tarun.
benefit_amount: Loans up to ₹10 lakhs without collateral
benefit_description: Shishu: up to ₹50,000 | Kishore: ₹50,001-5,00,000 | Tarun: ₹5,00,001-10,00,000. No collateral, no processing fee.
how_to_apply: Visit any bank/NBFC/MFI → Fill MUDRA loan application → Submit KYC documents → Bank processes → Loan sanctioned

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
description: Government savings scheme for the girl child offering high interest rates and tax benefits. Account for girls below 10 years.
benefit_description: Minimum ₹250/year, maximum ₹1.5 lakh/year. Matures when girl turns 21. Partial withdrawal at 18 for higher education.
how_to_apply: Visit any post office or authorized bank → Fill SSY form → Submit birth certificate of girl child → Open account with minimum ₹250

name: PM Vishwakarma Yojana
description: End-to-end support for traditional artisans and craftspeople through recognition, skill training, toolkit incentives, and credit support.
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
benefit_description: PM Vishwakarma Certificate, ₹500/day training stipend, ₹15,000 free toolkit, loans at 5% (₹1L then ₹2L), digital marketing support.
how_to_apply: Register on PM Vishwakarma portal → Verified by Gram Panchayat/ULB → Skill training → Get toolkit and credit support
